name: mfg-transfer-planner
description: Aquilair multi-plant material transfer planner as a standalone expert: plant shortage response, transferable material matching across plants, transfer plan generation and evaluation (total cost / transport days / fulfillment rate), sandbox branch what-if simulation, and controlled execution after confirmation. Ships mfg-transfer-allocation and aquilair-data-delivery skills.
license: Proprietary - Aquilair internal distribution, intranet use only

displayDescription.en: Standalone multi-plant transfer expert: shortage response, transferable stock matching, plan generation with evaluation, sandbox branch simulation and controlled execution via confirmation cards.
displayDescription.zh: 多工厂调拨独立专家：缺货响应、可调出物料匹配、方案生成与评估、沙箱分支推演、确认卡受控执行。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 上海工厂反馈缺货，帮我匹配可调出物料并生成调拨方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: A plant reported a material shortage - match available transferable stock and generate a transfer plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 上海工厂反馈缺货，帮我匹配可调出物料并生成调拨方案
quickPrompts.en: A plant reported a material shortage - match available transferable stock and generate a transfer plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 在沙箱分支里推演这个调拨方案，和生产分支对比差异
quickPrompts.en: Simulate this transfer plan on a sandbox branch and compare the differences with the production branch.

quickPrompts.zh: 当前调拨方案的总成本、运输天数和满足率评估如何？
quickPrompts.en: How are the total cost, transport days and fulfillment rate of the current transfer plan evaluated?
